top_signals.title: Inflation Will Persistently Stay Above the Fed's Target, Hooper Says
top_signals.summary: Man Group Chief Market Strategist Kristina Hooper says inflation will persistently stay above the Federal Reserve's target. She speaks on "Bloomberg Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Court freezes Trump administration bid for nationwide CDL database
top_signals.summary:
A coalition of U.S. states persuaded a federal judge to temporarily block the Department of Homeland Security from obtaining commercial driver records.
